summary: Reconstruct one non-Cartesian image from multi-coil k-space and sensitivity maps.
notes: Sensitivity-map estimation belongs to the planned org.kspacejet.calibration/sensitivity_map_estimate Operator. This consumer must receive its immutable sensitivity maps through a future explicit calibration binding, never by inferring or retaining hidden shared Provider state. Solver, trajectory, device, finite resource, cancellation, and EndOfInput behavior are deferred to an executable contract.
